units.source_text: 但是，对口买来的点心不是为了充饥，也不是为了服安眠药用。

en.t: But the sweets I had bought because they suited my taste were not meant to fill my stomach, nor were they for taking sleeping pills.

units.source_text: 勉强地说，是一种不安的情绪促使我买来的。

en.t: If I had to put it into words, I had bought them because I was driven by a feeling of unease.
